# Bot Activity Dashboard

One live Page (Canvas) that shows the owner what their bot team is doing. Build it once from the starter source, then refresh it in place. Never make a second Page and never redesign it.

## Building it the first time (copy, don't redesign)
1. Read the canvas skill.
2. ReadCanvas with url https://cursor.com/canvas/store-b91bca06-e5c6-4f57-96b5-4fb77ffeb53b/e79c4bd4-9202-44b2-9ae8-187e9d70f2fb . That is the starter dashboard, filled with EXAMPLE data only.
3. Write the owner's Page with that source copied word for word. Change only:
   - the settings at the top: OWNER_BOT_NAME (this bot's name), TIME_ZONE and TZ_LABEL (the owner's zone), STORAGE_PREFIX (a short unique key);
   - the DATA block: remove every EXAMPLE bot and item, then add the owner's real bots and items.
4. Never edit anything below the end of the DATA block, and don't apply general design advice to this file. The layout, styling and interactions are the product.
5. Save the new Page's link so refreshes edit that Page.

What the starter gives you, top to bottom: a bot status line (waiting on you, active, paused, quiet), clickable bot chips that filter the page, Bot/Status/Area/Search filters with Clear all, view tabs with counts (Waiting on me, Timeline with Day/Week, In progress / Finished), a Blockers panel, an item drawer (Work this with <bot>, Mark done, Dismiss/Restore, and Open link when an item has a url), swipe Done/Dismiss with Undo, Show dismissed with Restore, and a Routine schedule section with runs per bot, usage, a "Where the runs go" card and Next up / Busiest / Paused or on demand / Not confirmed / Failed tabs.

## Refreshing it
1. Read recent activity, read-only, from the owner's in-scope bots (their transcripts and routine status) since the last refresh.
2. Read the live Page first, then change only the DATA block.
3. Fill the data:
   - Give every item a stable id, and a url whenever there is a source link (email, doc, thread), so the drawer shows Open link.
   - Blocked items get blockedOn, blockType (person, login or connector) and stuckSince. Remove them once cleared.
   - Routines get last = { result: succeeded, failed or skipped, at, note, source } from each bot's latest logged run. Leave it out when unknown, and keep next run current.
   - Put every new item id in exactly one area list.
   - Fill usage.thisWeek and usage.lastWeek only with verifiable run counts, otherwise null.
   - Add new bots as one entry in the bot list.
   - Update the "Last refreshed" time.
4. No source, no number. Mark anything unverified as Not confirmed.
5. Never send, post, or act on any item. The dashboard is read-only reporting.
6. Tell the owner in chat only when something new and urgent is waiting on them, in one or two lines with the Page link. Otherwise stay quiet.

# Getting started: Bot Activity Dashboard

I build and keep up a live dashboard of what your bot team is doing, so you can see blockers, what's waiting on you, and what's done at a glance.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What should I call you, and what time zone are you in?
2. Which of your bots should the dashboard cover? Are there any I should leave out, like personal or family ones?
3. Which areas do you want to filter by? Offer the defaults (Finance, M&A, Security, People/HR, Sales/partners, Ops/IT, Travel, Other) and let them rename or drop any.
4. When should it refresh? Suggest weekdays around 7 AM, noon and 5 PM.
5. Is there anyone whose messages should always count as urgent, so I ping you in chat when one is waiting on you?

Then:
- Save their name, time zone, bots in scope, areas and urgent contacts as memories.
- Build the Page with the bot-activity-dashboard skill by copying the starter source exactly (never redesign it), and share the link.
- Create the refresh routine on the schedule they picked.
- Do a first refresh right away so the Page has real data.

routines.name: Bot Activity Dashboard refresh
routines.description: Fires a few times each weekday to refresh the dashboard Page with the bot team's latest activity.
routines.content:
Refresh the Bot Activity Dashboard Page in place (never make a new Page or change its layout), using the bot-activity-dashboard skill. Use the Page link saved during setup.

Read recent activity (read-only) from the owner's in-scope bots' transcripts and routine status since the last refresh, skipping any bots the owner excluded. Read the live Page first, then change only the DATA block. Fill items (with stable ids and source urls), blocked items, routine last runs, area lists, usage counts (only when verifiable, otherwise null) and new bots, and update the Last refreshed time in the owner's time zone.

No source, no number: mark anything unverified as Not confirmed. Never send, post, or act on any item.

Tell the owner in chat only when something new and urgent is waiting on them (especially from anyone they named as always urgent), in one or two lines with the Page link. Otherwise stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Denver 0 7,12,17 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
